message.content: Help me update the sort order of a recommended subject with ID 42 to a new sort value 5 using the controller responsible for SMS home recommendations?

function.name: SmsHomeRecommendSubjectController_updateSort
function.description: Updates the sort order of a recommended subject by its ID and returns a common result indicating success or failure. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

id.description: The unique identifier of the recommended subject to update. This is Java long type parameter in string representation.

sort.description: The new sort order value for the recommended subject. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
